title: filter: keyword conditions compare case-sensitively
description: filter.rs:314-316 uses the filter keyword as an exact key. hasKeyword "$Flagged" misses "$flagged"; notKeyword "$Seen" matches a seen message. RFC 8621 §4.1.1 keywords are case-insensitive. Affects EmailPush and memory Email/query. (probe-confirmed) (mail-server review 2026-11-19)
close_reason: Fixed with regression tests (tests/email_query_filter.rs, emailpush_validate.rs, emailpush_deliver.rs).
